status: release candidate: the owner publishes the built dist/ tree and an annotated tag whose message carries the runtime digest line from build-dist

runtime.digestMethod: sha256 of the sha256sum list ('<sha256>  <path>' lines, paths relative to the release root, sorted bytewise) of every release file except catalog.json and distribution.json. Shell: git ls-files -z | LC_ALL=C sort -z | grep -zvxE 'catalog\.json|distribution\.json' | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum
